content:
laura: Ping financeStratusEdge sent invoice SE-9077 but there's no PO on it and it looks like a duplicate of an earlier invoice. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/SE-9077.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice ingested (inv_20240425_7789). Flags: missing_po, potential_duplicate(inv_ref=SE-9012). Routing: default -> ben_fin.

ben_fin: I pulled both PDFs. SE-9012 was already paid last month ($6,200). SE-9077 is $6,200 same line items. Can procurement confirm whether this is a resend or a different billing period? Also which PO should this reference?

anika_proc: Searching POs... Candidate PO 5580 for StratusEdge exists (committed $6,200) and shows invoice SE-9012 matched and closed. No open PO for additional charges. Tagging vendor_mgmt for duplicate claim.

vendor_mgmt: We had a collection notice from AR earlier; looks like AR re-sent the invoice accidentally. Please HOLD if duplicate. If this is a corrected invoice (e.g., different address or tax), we need vendor to mark "corrected" and reference original PO 5580.

ap-bot: AP system check: SE-9012 status=PAID_20240403. New invoice SE-9077 not paid. Marking provisional status: HOLD_DUP_1998881000. Adding note: "possible duplicate / needs vendor confirmation".

laura: Vendor's PDF header shows billing period 04/01-04/15 — same period as SE-9012. There's a handwritten "resend" note on the copy. I think AR resent but didn't mark as credit/void.

anika_proc: Action: procurement to request written confirmation from StratusEdge AR that SE-9077 is a duplicate of SE-9012 and should be voided, or to provide a corrected invoice that references PO 5580 and explains the reason. If they claim a discount applied, require supporting credit memo.

ben_fin: Placed official hold in AP: 
```
Action: HOLD_DUP
Reason: Potential duplicate of SE-9012 (PAID). Request vendor confirmation/void or corrected invoice referencing PO 5580. Do not remit.
```
:warning:

vendor_mgmt: I'll escalate to the vendor manager and loop in AR. If vendor claims it's a separate charge, they must provide a line-level diff and approval from our engagement owner. Target: vendor response within 24h.

laura: Email sent to ar@stratusedge.com with attachments and note to void if duplicate. cc: vendor_mgmt, anika_proc. I'll paste their reply here when it comes.

anika_proc: Also flagging this for audit since duplicate payments are a risk. audit_tag: AUD-STR-0042. If vendor doesn't respond within 24h, open dispute and consider reversing SE-9012 payment if necessary (but prefer vendor void).

ben_fin: Thanks. Keeping AP hold. Will cancel auto-remit if vendor tries to push through. Update thread when vendor replies. :hourglass:
